title: getagentseal/codeburn
claim: getagentseal/codeburn — Free, local tool to track AI coding token usage and cost across 31 tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini
why_good: It addresses a growing need for transparency and cost management in AI development, which is often overlooked by developers focused on building.
value: Companies using AI tools would pay for advanced analytics and reporting features to optimize their token usage and reduce costs.
risk: The project could fail if larger companies integrate similar tracking features into their existing tools, making it redundant.
